hooks.command: root="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; if [ ! -f "$root/scripts/guard/claude_hook.py" ]; then top="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; case "$top" in "$root"/.claude/worktrees/*) root="$top" ;; esac; fi; node "$root/scripts/launcher/launch.ts" system -m scripts.guard.claude_hook || { echo "The repository safety check in scripts/guard blocked this command or could not run. If there is no reason above this line, ask the user to fix it." >&2; exit 2; }
